title: approved-list-signature
description: The detached signature over an approved-list document's exact bytes: ECDSA P-256 over the SHA-256 of the document, DER-encoded, made with the Admin's list-signing key on the Admin's own computer (Sign-ApprovedList.ps1). keyId names which of the agent's compiled-in list keys made it (the SHA-256 of that key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo), so a second key can be added before the first is retired. The same shape as a release signature, but a different key: the release key never signs a list, and the list key never signs a release.

signature.description: Base64 of the DER-encoded ECDSA signature (at most 72 bytes).
